defects.summary: TemplateBoilerplate was a basic mock lacking dynamic schedule, accessible RSVP, and skip button
defects.rootCause: Initial boilerplate layout contained hardcoded static timetable and blocking alert() calls
defects.fix: Rewrote component as a full-featured accessible layout supporting programDays, clean RSVP confirmation, min 44px Skip opening, and lightbox Escape support

defects.summary: WaxSealEnvelope lacked accessible skip button and keyboard activation
defects.rootCause: Opening relied on mouse click on envelope seal without keyboard Enter/Space or skip link
defects.fix: Added accessible Skip button and onKeyDown handler for Enter and Space keys

defects.summary: Curtain opening container caused horizontal scroll overflow on 320px screens and lacked skip link
defects.rootCause: Fixed width on curtain button container and missing skip option
defects.fix: Added clamp() scaling, constrained container with max-width calc(100vw - 32px), and added min 44px Skip opening button

defects.summary: AnimatePresence mode='wait' caused exit animations to stall in headless testing environments
defects.rootCause: Framer Motion mode='wait' required complete transition event before mounting replacement
defects.fix: Refactored to standard AnimatePresence, added previewStartClosed prop, and added accessible Skip button

defects.summary: Lightbox modal lacked accessible dialog roles and Escape key listener; mobile nav was hidden
defects.rootCause: Basic overlay with display:none mobile nav rule in withjoy-portal.css
defects.fix: Added role='dialog', aria-modal='true', Escape key listener, focus return, and smooth horizontal scroll pill navigation on mobile

defects.summary: React 19 compiler manual memoization preservation lint error in handleOpenInvitation
defects.fix: Updated dependencies array to [reduced, setOpened] and removed unused imports
